svg.title: CarePlan: R4 to R5 and R4 to R6
svg.text: Every R4 / R4B element in the middle. Left: what it became in R5. Right: what it became in R6.
activity.detail is gone in R5 and R6
17 inline sub-elements dropped. Describe planned work in a request resource and point to it with plannedActivityReference.
Sources: hl7.org/fhir/R4B/careplan.html · hl7.org/fhir/R5/careplan.html · hl7.org/fhir/6.0.0-ballot3/careplan.html (R6 not yet final; may still change).
